answer: Under EigenTrust, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once. Freshly spawned Sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits circular self-endorsement. Like onyx set into a basalt trellis, only durable links from established peers can support enough score to pass consensus.
